packaged_source_identity.fingerprint_method: Sort forward-slash relative file paths with ordinal string ordering. Append each UTF-8 path, one NUL byte, the unmodified file bytes, and one NUL byte to SHA-256. Source and extracted crate produce the same digest. This src-only digest is distinct from the benchmark runner's broader source fingerprint.
